name: Life spaceship 6573d1df on 3-uniform tiling k3-011
description: A period-4 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-011, with touching neighbours, 8 to 12 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,6,8,9,10,11,12/S0,2,3,7,8,9,10,11,12. JETCARP's Life census met it in 0.0% of its soups on this tiling.
